title: Calibration Days in the Repair Plan — Insurance Claim Repairs Calibration Desk Note
content:
Calibration days in the planned repair days of an Insurance Claim Repairs repair order follow the calibration order opened for the repair order under ADAS Sensor Calibrations, by that order's tier.

| Calibration order opened for the repair order | Calibration days added |
|---|---|
| Multi-System Calibration | 2 |
| Dual-Mode Camera Calibration | 2 |
| Static Camera Calibration | 1 |
| Blind Spot Radar Calibration | 1 |
| Front Radar Calibration | 1 |
| a calibration order of any other tier | none |
| no calibration order for the repair order | none |

**Clause.** A Multi-System Calibration or Dual-Mode Camera Calibration adds the multi-calibration days, 2 days; a Static Camera, Blind Spot Radar or Front Radar Calibration adds the single-calibration days, 1 day; and a repair order whose calibration order is of any other tier, or that has none, adds no calibration days.

### Points of reading

- The tier is read from the ADAS Sensor Calibrations order linked to this repair order, not from the sensors the vehicle carries.
- Calibration days are whole days and are counted as they stand.

### Hypothetical cases

- A repair order with a linked Front Radar Calibration order: 1 calibration day.
- A repair order with a linked Dual-Mode Camera Calibration order: 2 calibration days.
- A repair order with no linked calibration order: no calibration days.
